pages.text: Attacks ignore armor, enchantments, and resistances.$(br)Killing mobs additionally drops 2 Delight-type drops (if they have any).$(br)Right-click to harvest crops, producing 2 extra drops and reverting their growth stage by one.
Place an Apocalyptium Smithing Template, a Cursed Metal Knife, and an Apocalyptium Ingot into a smithing table to forge an Apocalyptium Knife.
